questions.passage: In the past, the division of labor was mostly limited to workplaces such as factories, farms, and restaurants. At home, most people were cooking, cleaning, and doing laundry by themselves until the 1990s, even as microwaves, laundry machines, and dishwashers made house chores easier and less time-consuming. Over the last two decades, however, economizing habits have thoroughly penetrated our life, resulting in further division of labor. Outsourcing is no longer a term reserved only for multinational corporations or the rich.
questions.prompt: What change in the reach of division of labor is described?
options: Outsourcing has become reserved exclusively for wealthy corporations.
Domestic appliances eliminated every household responsibility immediately.
The division of labor disappeared from workplaces after the 1990s.
Economising and outsourcing have spread beyond workplaces into everyday life.
questions.promptZh: 本段描述劳动分工的范围发生什么变化？
optionsZh: 外包变得只允许富有公司使用。
家电立即消除了所有家庭责任。
1990 年代后分工从工作场所消失。
节约效率与外包从工作场所扩展到日常生活。

B easier and less time-consuming 不等于彻底消失。
C 原文是进一步分工，不是工作场所停止分工。
D 从 past mostly workplaces 到 economizing habits...our life，说明范围扩展。last two decades 以原书叙述为基准，不直接当作今日统计。

questions.passage: In academia, big team science is taking over traditional small lab science, requiring a great degree of division of labor. In big team social psychology, someone has to prepare experimental materials, someone else has to run the study, someone else has to clean up the data, someone else has to analyze it, someone else has to interpret it, and so on. Each team member does their part; then the team quickly assembles all the parts and moves on to the next paper.
questions.prompt: How does the passage describe big-team social psychology work?
options: One person always performs every operation without collaborators.
Different people handle materials, study execution, data work and interpretation.
No team member has a distinct role.
The team stops after preparing materials and never assembles a paper.
questions.promptZh: 本段怎样描述大型团队社会心理学工作？
optionsZh: 总由一人独自完成全部操作。
不同人分别处理材料、执行研究、数据与解释。
没有任何成员有不同分工。
准备材料后就停止，从不组装论文。
analyses: A 多个 someone else 明确不同人接手。
B materials、run、clean/analyze、interpret 依次列出任务。
C each...their part 表示各有分工。
D 后面明确 assemble...parts 然后进入下一篇；本段描述流程，不直接判定每篇质量或体验好坏。

someone else has to interpret it

questions.passage: Marx was further concerned that the division of labor would make laborers simpletons: “It increases the social productive power of labor, not only for the benefit of the capitalist instead of for that of the labourer, but it does this by crippling the individual labourers.” Marx argued that the division of labor “mortifies the body and ruins the mind.”

options: It benefits laborers by developing all their faculties.
It reduces social output while enriching individual workers.
It benefits capitalists without affecting individual laborers.
It benefits capitalists while damaging individual laborers.
questions.promptZh: 引述的 Marx 论述怎样限定生产力的提高？
optionsZh: 通过发展全部能力而使劳动者受益。
降低社会产出，同时丰富个体劳动者。
使资本家受益，却不影响个体劳动者。
使资本家受益，同时损害个体劳动者。
analyses: A instead of for...the labourer 否定了这里把劳动者当作主要受益者的读法。
B It increases 明说提高生产力；不能把个体受损改成社会产出下降。
C by crippling 表明提高生产力伴随个体受损，不是毫无影响。
D for the benefit of the capitalist 与 crippling the individual labourers 同时支持此项。mortifies...ruins 是 Marx 的批判性措辞，不是本段测得的普遍医学结果。

questions.passage: In his presidential address to the American Sociological Association in 1985, Kai Erikson discussed how Marx’s theory of alienation is still relevant in the modern workplace. Specifically, he argued that the key sources of alienation boil down to “those structures in the modern workplace that subdivide labor into narrower and narrower specialties, and, second, those structures in the modern workplace that limit the amount of control workers exercise over the work they do.” Clerical workers are subject to quotas, routines, and constant monitoring by their managers.
questions.prompt: Which setting is given for Kai Erikson's discussion?
questions.promptZh: Kai Erikson 的讨论被放在哪个场合？
options: Erik Erikson's lecture defining playfulness in 1980.
Adam Smith's original 1776 pin-factory visit.
His 1985 presidential address to the American Sociological Association.
A present-day clinical session held for every factory worker.
optionsZh: Erik Erikson在1980年定义玩心的讲座。

对每位工厂工人进行的当代临床会谈。

D 理论相关性讨论不是全体工人的新临床会谈，也不以modern一词冒称当前已核验。

questions.translation: 1985 年，在美国社会学协会的主席演讲中，Kai Erikson 讨论了 Marx 的异化理论如何仍适用于现代工作场所。具体来说，他认为异化的主要来源归结为“现代工作场所中把劳动细分为越来越狭窄专业的那些结构，以及第二类结构——限制工人对自己所做工作行使多少控制权的结构”。文职人员受到配额、例行程序和管理者持续监督的约束。

questions.passage: Sociologist Melvin Kohn found some evidence in support of Marx’s speculations. For instance, he looked at survey data from 3,101 Americans employed in civilian occupations. He measured three dimensions of labor: closeness of supervision, routinization of work, and substantive complexity of work, as well as four specific aspects of alienation: powerlessness, self-estrangement, normlessness, and cultural estrangement.
questions.prompt: What did Kohn’s study examine in the survey sample?
options: Only productivity and wages among factory managers.
Three labor dimensions and four alienation aspects among 3,101 employed Americans.
Four labor dimensions and three alienation aspects among 3,101 students.
A randomized change of supervision among all American workers.
questions.promptZh: Kohn 的研究在调查样本中考察了什么？
optionsZh: 只考察工厂经理的产出与工资。
在 3,101 名就业美国人中考察三项劳动维度与四项异化方面。
在 3,101 名学生中考察四项劳动维度与三项异化方面。
随机改变全体美国工人的监督方式。
analyses: A 列出的指标是监督、例行化、复杂性及异化，非仅工资产出，也没限定工厂经理。
B 三项劳动维度、四项异化方面与 3,101 Americans employed in civilian occupations 均匹配。
C 对调三和四，还把就业样本换成学生。
D survey data 不等于随机干预；样本不等于全体工人。some evidence 支持理论，不是彻底证明全部推测。
